items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I know that's where I saw him. We played Kansas City.

ctx.x: See you liked to play with guys like that, so that's one of the main things that is outstanding about the whole sessions, you just liked to play with those guys. They were all good players.
When you went with Cab you replaced Leroy Maxey who had been with him for a long time.
Been with him as long as I knew. There was a Cab Calloway.
